transcript: Welcome aboard the Starship Sparkle, Ava! Our robot friends are getting ready for a big space dance. Look at these shiny robots! Ava, can you help them find partners? When every robot has a buddy, they make an even team. If one is left out, it is odd. Let's count them together in their neat rows. Time to load the glitter-fuel! We need to put the same number of batteries into each robot's power pack. When groups are equal, the robots can fly straight. Are these groups the same? Let's compare and count each one to be sure! Now, let's help the robots line up for their big dance move!
